The '''miniature proton torpedo launcher''' was a portable [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] that fired miniaturized proton torpedoes. It was originally designed as an integrated weapon for the [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The launcher was fitted into the Zero-G stormtrooper's left gauntlet which enabled them to rip through the hull of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in boarding missions. However, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] engineers adapted the weapon into a portable shoulder-mounted launcher.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />

Though not as powerful as the [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] fired from [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|starship launchers]], the miniature proton torpedo launcher was still a devastating weapon, dealing collateral damage to any targets within 3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of the primary blast radius. The miniature proton torpedo launcher could also be switched to an anti-vehicle mode. In this mode, the weapon would deal twice the damage but would only be able to attack very large targets such as [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />

The miniature proton torpedo launcher weighed 8 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and was able to fire 4 miniature proton torpedoes before needing to be reloaded. The weapon cost 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was available for military use only.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />
